from tools import search_flights, filter_flights, search_hotels, filter_hotels, search_restaurants, filter_restaurants, search_nearest, get_results_from_cache, save_to_cache

# Search for flights from Anchorage to Portland for the specified dates

    end_airport_city="Portland",
    departure_date=["May 16, 2025"],
    arrival_date=["May 28, 2025"],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Filter flights to ensure non-stop
filtered_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=flight_search,
    num_layovers=[0]
)

# Save the filtered flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_flights", value=filtered_flights)

# Search for hotels in Portland with a pool and wifi, and a 4.0 rating or higher
hotel_search = search_hotels(
    city="Portland",
    checkin_date=["May 16, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["May 28, 2025"],
    pool_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True,
    rating=[4.0, 5.0]
)

# Filter hotels to ensure they meet the rating criteria
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotel_search
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Search for restaurants in Portland with a 4.0 rating or higher

    city="Portland",
    rating=[4.0, 5.0]
)

# Filter restaurants to ensure they meet the rating criteria

    prior_results=restaurant_search
)

# Save the filtered restaurant results to cache
